title: Evaluation of the unfolded circuit
statement: Let $C$ be a Boolean directed acyclic circuit whose gates have pairwise distinct input vertices and whose NOT gates each have exactly one input. For every Boolean assignment $x$ to its $n$ input variables, the tree obtained by unfolding $C$ computes the same value as $C$ under $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Every gate has pairwise distinct input vertices
Every NOT gate has exactly one input
An assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ input variables
